name: fogleman/sdf
role: Python library for composing signed-distance fields and generating 3D meshes
notes: 2026-11-15: Assess because it offers implicit-shape generation distinct from B-rep CAD and mesh processing. Revisit after confirming the repository-to-package relationship and current install route.
2026-11-15: Assessment uncertainty: no current release date or published package route was established; documented installation is from the GitHub source repository.

evidence.result: README classic sphere(1) & box(1.5) minus three cylinder(0.5) cuts at default resolution: 291028 triangles, 145506 welded vertices, bounds exactly +-0.75, max vertex residual 0.00228 against the analytic composed SDF, 0 boundary/non-manifold edges; second run byte-identical. Python 3.12.2, numpy 2.5.5, scikit-image 0.26.0, macOS arm64.
evidence.scope: Python classic CSG to binary STL at default resolution: triangle count, bounds, watertight; no meshio formats, OpenVDB, other primitives or render; macOS arm64.

summary: Python library for defining signed-distance functions with composable primitives and Boolean operations, then generating mesh files such as STL. It offers a compact code-first route to implicit geometry; it is not a general CAD modeller or renderer.
use_when: Generate procedural STL geometry from SDF primitives in Python
Use implicit unions, intersections and differences for code-defined shapes
avoid_when: Use Blender for general mesh modelling, materials and rendering
Use a CAD tool when dimensioned parametric solids and assemblies are required

install.macos: Clone the official repository and install in a Python virtual environment with `pip install -e .`

assessment.version_seen: Current repository README; no release version confirmed
assessment.last_release: unknown (release date not established from pages read)
assessment.rationale: Official README documents Python SDF composition and mesh export, repository identifies MIT licence and installation from source with dependencies. Release recency was not established, so maintenance remains unknown.
